text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Tunnel di e-power: infrastruttura di ricarica per una logistica dei trasporti sostenibile.", "gist": "The e-power tunnel is a charging infrastructure for sustainable transport logistics."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Galliker Transport AG", "gist": "Galliker Transport AG, a family-owned company"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Per la Galliker Transport AG non si tratta solo di uno slogan, ma di una ricetta di successo che dura da oltre un secolo.", "gist": "For Galliker Transport AG, it is not just a slogan but a successful recipe lasting over a century."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Green Logistics by Galliker", "gist": "Green Logistics by Galliker, the company's guidelines"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "la famiglia s’impegna pertanto a un comportamento imprenditoriale sostenibile e a un trattamento rispettoso delle persone, dell’ambiente e della natura.", "gist": "The family commits to sustainable business practices and respectful treatment of people, environment, and nature."}]}
